propositions: Tolerant Pydantic parsing can normalize structurally divergent provider/model responses to empty results that are incorrectly treated as valid review outcomes
Semantically empty verification (raw-empty or malformed-to-empty) must be rejected and never produce a valid pass or valid empty review outcome
Empty or unrecoverable verification results are already classified as indeterminate by pass3_decide's no-verification rule, enforcing AC3 across both raw-empty and malformed-to-empty paths

Telemetry must distinguish four outcome buckets (clean, recovered, empty_outcomes, unrecoverable) at the kernel function level; pipeline-level wiring into plan_review_decide and code_review_decide is a follow-up concern
Flexible parsing and bounded retry/self-healing must be preserved for provider-independent resilience while rejecting semantically empty outcomes
Shipped verify_findings kernel function already implements empty-outcome detection, StructuredOutputError handling, and all four outcome_counts buckets with unit test coverage
